bands.label: Lv 1
bands.name: Level 1 · Beginner
bands.brief: TOPIK I, 80/200. Survival Korean: greetings, numbers, family, food, places, the most common verbs and adjectives.

bands.label: Lv 2
bands.name: Level 2 · Elementary
bands.brief: TOPIK I, 140/200. Daily life and public places: hospital, post office, travel, weather, plans, common adverbs.

bands.label: Lv 3
bands.name: Level 3 · Intermediate
bands.brief: TOPIK II, 120/300. Social life and everyday topics; the level most Korean universities ask for. Sino-Korean nouns and 하다 verbs.

bands.label: Lv 4
bands.name: Level 4 · Upper-intermediate
bands.brief: TOPIK II, 150/300. News, work and public issues: policy, economy, society; connectives used in reading passages.

bands.label: Lv 5
bands.name: Level 5 · Advanced
bands.brief: TOPIK II, 190/300. Academic and professional Korean: abstract nouns, formal verbs, essay vocabulary.

bands.label: Lv 6
bands.name: Level 6 · Mastery
bands.brief: TOPIK II, 230/300. Editorials, research and literature: nuanced formal vocabulary and hanja idioms.
